description: mstsc.exe invoked against a .rdp file residing in a mail-attachment, download, or temp directory - consistent with Turla's STOCKSTAY .rdp phishing-attachment initial access.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/google-details-turlas-new-stockstay.html
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/stockstay-turla-intelligence-gathering
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1021.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\mstsc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '.rdp'
  context:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - 'Content.Outlook'
      - 'INetCache'
      - '\Olk\'
  condition: selection and context
level: high
2517.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Endpoint.Processes.process_name=mstsc.exe Endpoint.Processes.process="*.rdp*" (Endpoint.Processes.process="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Endpoint.Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Endpoint.Processes.process="*Content.Outlook*" OR Endpoint.Processes.process="*INetCache*" OR Endpoint.Processes.process="*\\Olk\\*") by Endpoint.Processes.dest Endpoint.Processes.user Endpoint.Processes.parent_process_name Endpoint.Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - lastTime
2517.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\mstsc.exe OR *\\MSTSC.exe) @CommandLine:(*.rdp* OR *.RDP*) @CommandLine:(*\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *Content.Outlook* OR *INetCache* OR *\\Olk\\*)
2517.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\mstsc\.exe$/i CommandLine=/\.rdp/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|Content\\.Outlook|INetCache|Olk)\\\\", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine], function=count())

2613.sent:
let lookback = 1d;
let failThreshold = 30;   // FortiGate default lockout = 2 fails; 30+ from one src = automated 'forticheck' stuffing
let Failures = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where DeviceVendor has "Fortinet"
    | where Activity has_any ("login fail","ssl-login-fail","admin-login-failed") or DeviceEventClassID in ("0101039426","0100032002")
    | summarize FailCount = count(), TargetedUsers = dcount(coalesce(DestinationHostName, SourceUserName)), firstFail = min(TimeGenerated), lastFail = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP
    | where FailCount >= failThreshold;
let Successes = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where DeviceVendor has "Fortinet"
    | where Activity has_any ("login success","ssl-login","admin-login") or DeviceEventClassID in ("0101039424","0100032001")
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SuccessUser = coalesce(DestinationHostName, SourceUserName);
Failures
| join kind=inner Successes on SourceIP
| where SuccessTime between (firstFail .. lastFail + 2h)
| project SourceIP, FailCount, TargetedUsers, firstFail, lastFail, SuccessTime, SuccessUser
| order by FailCount desc
2613.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.vendor_product="Fortinet FortiGate" by Authentication.src, Authentication.action, _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| stats sum(eval(if(action="failure",count,0))) as failures, sum(eval(if(action="success",count,0))) as successes, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime by src
| where failures>=30 AND successes>=1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - failures

2614.sent:
let lookback = 1d;
let ipFanoutThreshold = 20;   // one account succeeding from 20+ distinct source IPs/day = planted/shared backdoor credential (Zenox: same creds across thousands of IPs)
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where DeviceVendor has "Fortinet"
| where Activity has_any ("login success","ssl-login","tunnel-up") or DeviceEventClassID in ("0101039424","0101039947","0100032001")
| extend AcctUser = coalesce(DestinationHostName, SourceUserName)
| where isnotempty(AcctUser)
| summarize DistinctSourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP), SampleIPs = make_set(SourceIP, 10), Logins = count(), firstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), lastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AcctUser
| where DistinctSourceIPs >= ipFanoutThreshold
| order by DistinctSourceIPs desc
2614.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true dc(Authentication.src) as distinct_src, count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.vendor_product="Fortinet FortiGate" Authentication.action=success by Authentication.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| where distinct_src>=20
| sort - distinct_src

2615.def:
let lookback = 1d;
let accountFanout = 50;   // one source validating 50+ distinct harvested accounts/hr = credential-validation spray (FortiBleed: 924k NTLM / 130k Kerberos creds replayed)
IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where Protocol in ("Ntlm","Kerberos")
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize DistinctAccounts = dcount(AccountUpn), Failures = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed"), Successes = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"), SampleAccounts = make_set(AccountName, 20) by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DistinctAccounts >= accountFanout
| order by DistinctAccounts desc
2615.sent:
let lookback = 1d;
let accountFanout = 50;   // one source validating 50+ distinct harvested accounts/hr = credential-validation spray (FortiBleed: 924k NTLM / 130k Kerberos creds replayed)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4624, 4625)
| where AuthenticationPackageName in ("NTLM","Kerberos","Negotiate") or LogonProcessName has "NtLmSsp"
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-","::1","127.0.0.1")
| summarize DistinctAccounts = dcount(TargetUserName), Failures = countif(EventID == 4625), Successes = countif(EventID == 4624), SampleAccounts = make_set(TargetUserName, 20) by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctAccounts >= accountFanout
| order by DistinctAccounts desc
2615.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true dc(Authentication.user) as distinct_users, count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=failure (Authentication.signature_id=4625 OR Authentication.app=NTLM OR Authentication.app=Kerberos) by Authentication.src, _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| where distinct_users>=50
| sort - distinct_users
2615.falcon:
#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=3
| groupBy([RemoteAddressIP4], function=count(field=UserName, distinct=true, as=DistinctUsers))
| DistinctUsers >= 50
